HOW_TO_USE: The order of the entries below is the order the photos appear on the site (gallery, mosaic, lightbox).
To reorder: move an entire { ... } block up or down (keep the commas between blocks).
To hide a photo: delete its block (the file can stay in public/images).
To add a photo: put the .jpg in public/images and copy a block, changing 'file' and 'alt'.
'tags' choose where a photo is used in a specific spot. The FIRST photo in the list with a tag wins:
hero = big banner image at the top of pages | side = performance section | interior = interior section
roof = removable-roof section | trunk-rear = luggage section | engine = C8 page engine section | cockpit = C8 drive-modes section
The first 9 photos fill the big mosaic near the top of the Corvette pages, so put your best shots first.
After editing: commit and push in GitHub Desktop. Railway rebuilds the pages automatically.
